{{Quote|Foolish Jedi! We are the best of our series! Would you expect any less aboard Count Dooku's frigate?|B1 battle droid to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Bait">''[[The Clone Wars: Bait]]''</ref>}}
'''Count Dooku's frigate''' was a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class]] star [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] that served as the personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Dooku/Legends|leader]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:BestOfTheBestOfTheBestSirWithHonors-Bait.png|thumb|left|200px|B1 battle droids apprehend Anakin Skywalker]]
{{Quote|Captain, we've spotted the remains of a Jedi starfighter ahead. We're picking up one life-sign.''"<br />"''Tow it aboard and have a security detail standing ready!|A B1 battle droid and the B1 captain|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Bait" />}}
Dooku's frigate was equipped with an escape hatch located in his meditation chamber. The floor opened to a slide shaft leading to the hangar housing Dooku's [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|personal]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]]. The vessel was commanded by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] [[Unidentified droid captain/Legends|captain]] and crewed with top-of-the-line models of both the B1 series and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] series.

==History==
{{Quote|Obi-Wan Kenobi. I thought I sensed an unpleasant disturbance in the Force.|Dooku|<ref name="Dooku Captured" />}}
<div style="float:right">[[File:Kenobi_space_walk.png|thumb|left|200px|Obi-Wan Kenobi flies towards [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] frigate]]</div>
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] infiltrated this ship in his [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|personal]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B starfighter]]. He had rigged the ship to appear damaged and waited inside the cockpit for the crew of the ship to tow him into the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]]. After a short skirmish with the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] surrounding him, he was taken into custody after his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was shot and destroyed by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], wearing a [[Environment suit/Legends|space suit]], then infiltrated the ship and located Skywalker in a detention cell. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] made their way to Dooku's meditation chamber and confronted the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Before they could capture him, Dooku slid though a hidden escape hatch leading to the hangar deck.
